What should you know before starting UPSC preparation? AIR 48 Aniket Ranjan shares lessons from his own journey, including two failed Prelims attempts, the mistakes he made early on, and the changes that helped him improve his rank.

In a session organised by LevelUp IAS in collaboration with Kartavya Civil Society and Legacy – The History Society at Kirori Mal College, University of Delhi, Aniket spoke to students about understanding the syllabus and PYQs, developing analytical thinking, staying accountable, and preparing with the right direction. He also shared practical advice for college students considering the Civil Services Examination.
